about: The warehouse puzzle: walk around and push crates onto the marked spots. Crates can only be pushed, one at a time. Every level is built backwards from the solved warehouse, so it can always be solved, and each solved level unlocks a bigger one. Easy has 2 crates, Normal 3, Hard 4.
controls: Swipe to take one step (and push), or tap a square to walk there. Undo, Restart and Skip level buttons on the right. PC: arrow keys, U to undo, R to restart.
length: 1-10 min per level, endless levels (saves progress)
name: Sokoban
tagline: Push every crate onto a target. You can push, never pull.
